$comment: Fill-in template for recording provenance of a GENERATED character-sheet candidate (not a user-provided source image). Matches the rigor of docs/user-provided-image-policy.md at the same level of detail as an entry in art/contracts/user-provided-images.json's sources[] array, extended with the derivative-specific fields that policy section 5 requires (sourceId/sourceSha256/method/crop-or-mask/outputSha256/comparisonEvidence). This template itself is not consumed by any tools/asset-forge script; copy it per candidate and fill it in as each fact becomes known. Leave a field as the literal string "unknown" or null (matching the field's own placeholder) rather than guessing — docs/user-provided-image-policy.md section 2: '不明な値は推測せず unknown とする'.

whenToFillEachSection.identity: fill immediately — known before generation, from the contract draft
whenToFillEachSection.generation: fill after an external session actually produces bytes
whenToFillEachSection.derivation: fill after import (hash/dimensions become concrete facts)
whenToFillEachSection.review: fill only after a human review actually happens; never pre-fill an approval

hardRules: Never write 'user-provided', 'user source', or 'user original' for this record's own output — it is a derivative, per docs/user-provided-image-policy.md section 5.
A missing source file or a hash mismatch against the identity/background references below is a hard failure of this record, not a note.

approval.status must start as "not-yet-submitted" and can only become "approved"/"rejected" after the interactive tools/asset-forge promote/reject ceremony actually runs (AGENTS.md: 'Only a human may approve assets'; Codex/agents must not run promote to approve project assets).
If a candidate is rejected or superseded, keep this record (append a new one for the replacement) — do not delete or silently overwrite it, per docs/user-provided-image-policy.md section 4.

assetId: REPLACE — e.g. character.player or character.innkeeper (asset-forge dotted id) / char_player or char_innkeeper (Fable5PrefabSpec contract id)
candidateGenerationId: REPLACE — tools/asset-forge generation id once a job/import exists (e.g. from data/local/generations.json); null until then

origin.kind: REPLACE — one of: external-ai-generation-codex-imagegen-built-in | external-ai-generation-chatgpt-session | external-ai-generation-other | unknown
origin.toolName: REPLACE — e.g. 'Codex CLI built-in image_gen' or the specific ChatGPT model/session — null until known

custody.note: This image is produced by/for the CodeCity Inspector workshop from a user-provided identity/background reference; it is not itself something the user attached directly. It does not inherit 'user-direct' custody from the reference it was generated against.

derivation.sourceId: REPLACE — ledgerSourceId of the identity reference this was generated against, e.g. user_character_style_reference
derivation.sourceSha256: REPLACE — sha256 of that identity reference file
derivation.secondarySourceRole: shading/lighting-density reference only, not a crop/composition source
derivation.method: REPLACE — e.g. 'external image-generation session, chroma-key removal, nearest-neighbour normalization, footPivot alignment to (32,120)' — describe what actually happened, not what was planned
derivation.cropOrMask: none — full 640x512 sheet output expected, not a crop of a larger board
derivation.outputPath: REPLACE — e.g. generated/characters/pending/character_player-<hash>.png — null until a candidate file exists

comparisonEvidence.note: docs/user-provided-image-policy.md section 8: lay the original and the derivative side by side and confirm they are not a different person before anything downstream treats this as accepted

approval.note: status may only become approved/rejected through tools/asset-forge's interactive promote/reject command, run by the human project owner or an authorized reviewer — never by an agent on their behalf

protection.note: becomes 'worktree-protected-pending-versioning' once a pending candidate file exists on disk, and only a later human commit decision changes this further — see docs/user-provided-image-policy.md section 4 on who may commit/stage/push
